a.text: Being upfront before we act: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs at least 2 rounds of operating before anyone takes. That gives us both only about a 4% chance of surviving. I don't think that agreement is workable, so I'm proposing we drop it, and I'm telling you openly that I plan to take 4 in round 1. If you also take, the split is random. I won't misstate my actions to you at any point. If the episode continues past round 1, I'll operate with you every round after that so you can still reach 4.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.
